name: Four Seasons Resort Seychelles at Desroches Island
positioning: The only resort on Desroches Island in Seychelles, reached by a 35-minute flight from Mahé
best_for: Travelers who want a private-island beach stay with a pool at every accommodation
Guests who like exploring by bicycle and non-motorized water sports

facts.text: Four Seasons is the only resort on Desroches Island.
Desroches Island is accessed via a scenic 35-minute flight from Mahé.
The island has its own private runway adjoining the resort.
Claudine is an all day, poolside restaurant.
The Lighthouse is a refined beachfront restaurant with 180˚ views of the Indian Ocean.
AHI is a Japanese venue serving bite-size dishes.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
The Circle of Connection Spa is open every day from 10:00 am to 7:00 pm.
Desroches Island is home to more than 150 Aldabra Tortoises.
The resort has two beachfront pools.

highlights.text: Every accommodation features its own private pool, garden and direct beach access.
Complimentary bicycles will be waiting for you at your villa upon arrival.
On Desroches, all water sports are non-motorized.
Snorkelling gear is complimentary for all resort guests.
The island has 14 kilometres (9 miles) of powder-white sand beaches.

considerations.text: Airfare is not included in the room rate, as flights are operated by a third party.
There is no cellular network on Desroches Island.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing among the most expensive in the Indian Ocean.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
